dedupe_keys.name: data for the publication wind farm layout optimization with alignment constraints submitted to wind energy science 2024

description: A wind-farm optimisation research team publishes this Zenodo release of computed layouts from numerical examples in a study of alignment-constrained layout optimisation. A public Python reader script and a pickle file are listed under CC BY 4.0. The layouts can serve as comparison solutions when testing wind-turbine placement constraints or wake-aware optimisation routines. No related catalogue record explicitly covers these optimum-layout outputs. A limitation is that the landing page does not state the site, turbine count, wind rose, objective values, constraint matrices or coordinate units. The associated paper is described as submitted in 2024; publication status was not verified. The pickle format is Python-specific and can execute code when loaded, so users should inspect provenance and use a controlled environment before opening it. Results are algorithmic examples, not built farms or measured performance. Neither the pickle nor the script was downloaded or run, and no optimality claim was checked.
